title: docs(skills): objectstack-data teaches an object extension's fieldPatches — relabel a vendor field without redeclaring it in fields
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiHXKqxUqDPJKZyNHP7BoqTb)_

Fixes #28730

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：对外发布的 `objectstack-data` skill 的「Object Extension Model」一节新增一段，教对象扩展的 `fieldPatches`：改厂商字段的显示文字（label、description、inlineHelpText、placeholder、按存储 `value` 定位的选项 label）用它，而不是在 `fields` 里把字段重新声明一遍（那会整个接管字段，厂商升级不再到达）；租户自己改过的文字优先，两个扩展冲突时 `priority` 高者胜，指向目标对象没有的字段或选项值的补丁在安装时和 `os validate` 被拒，picklist 绑定字段的选项不可补丁；附 `crm_account.industry` → "Sector" 一例。另加一条 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset。
- **为什么改**：PR #28728 让 `fieldPatches` 真正生效后，skill 还只教 `fields` / `priority`，照 skill 写代码的 AI 想把 "Industry" 显示成 "Sector" 只会在 `fields` 里重声明字段、把它接管过去；这是那张 PR 欠下的 `Skills-docs` 后续。
- **风险与回滚**：只改一个 SKILL.md 与一条 changeset；不动 spec、运行时、`content/docs/**`、ratchet 脚本、任何 ceiling。文件 token 数仍在上限内（6111 / 6123）：新段落靠删同文件里的重复句付账——搜索一节第二段的「refused loudly」复述（并入第一段）、索引一节的 blockquote（`rules/indexing.md` 已有）、校验类型清单（`rules/validation.md` 已有）。风险在折叠处：读者要多开一个 rules 文件才看到被折叠的细节。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` 「Object Extension Model」新段（事实逐条对照 `packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.ts` 的 `BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST` 与 `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `patchedField` / `mergeObjectDefinitions`）；② 同文件三处删减是否真是复述；③ `.changeset/28730-skill-field-patches.md`。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` —— 预期含 `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md is 6111 tokens (ceiling 6123; headroom 12)`，末行 `57 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`。
- **需要你做的**：Tier H（`skills/**`）—— 授权账号 APPROVE 一次，席位落地；无其它动作。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, section *Object Extension Model*: one paragraph on `fieldPatches` plus the `crm_account.industry` example from the `.changeset/28565-field-patch-applied.md` release note. Every claim is read off the live code at `b48eeb16c4` (this branch's merge base), not the card's summary:

| Claim in the paragraph | Source |
|:--|:--|
| Redeclaring the field in `fields` takes it over whole | `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:701-703` (`merged.fields = { ...base.fields, ...extension.fields }`); `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx:96-100` |
| Display keys only: `label`, `description`, `inlineHelpText`, `placeholder`; an option's `label` | `packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.ts:75-80` (`BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST.field` / `.option`); `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:4958-4967` (the slot's `.describe()`) |
| An option is addressed by its stored `value` | `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:585-587`; `packages/metadata-core/src/extension-field-patch-targets.ts:130-136` |
| Type, values and rules stay the owner's | `field-customization.ts:65-68`; `object.zod.ts:4960-4962` |
| A key the tenant edited keeps the tenant's text | `registry.ts:576`, `:592` (`tenantPatched` yield), `:731-734` |
| Between two extensions the higher `priority` wins | `registry.ts:4202-4203` (ascending sort), `:735-736` (the higher one written last) |
| A missing field or option value is refused at install and by `os validate` | `extension-field-patch-targets.ts:95-103` (field), `:126-137` (option); `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:2136-2146` (`400 VALIDATION_ERROR`); `packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts:732-745` |
| A `picklist`-bound field's options are never patchable | `extension-field-patch-targets.ts:112-124` (`picklist-option`); `registry.ts:581-582` |

`.changeset/28730-skill-field-patches.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch — the skill ships in that package's `dist` (`packages/skills/package.json` `files[]`, synced from `skills/**` by its build).

**Token ratchet — paid by deleting restatement in the same file** (standing ruling, maintainer 2026-10-27: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 — quoted for the record; no ceiling moves here):

| Deleted | Why it was restatement |
|:--|:--|
| *Search Fields* L171-176: "Both spellings are refused loudly … Each message carries its own prescription." and "Cross-object search paths are rejected by design … the mirror field is the answer." | Repeats the section's own L122-129 ("is **refused**, not silently dropped"; "This is the one prescription — emit it every time"). The one fact only that paragraph carried, the `searchable-field-unknown` lint code, is folded into L125. |
| *Index Patterns* blockquote L360-364 (retired `type` / `partial`, unique scope spellings) | Carried by `rules/indexing.md` L26-34 and L63-77; the pointer sentence below it now names the retired keys and the scope words. |
| *Validation Patterns* L331-337: the six-bullet type list with one-line glosses | Carried by `rules/validation.md`'s type table (L16-22); the names stay as one line. |

Readings (lines by `wc -l`; tokens in the ratchet's own convention, `ceil(bytes/4)` minus the stamp line):

| Reading | Before (`origin/main` `b48eeb16c4`) | After (this head) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | 472 lines · 6101 tokens (ceiling 6123) | 468 lines · 6111 tokens (headroom 12) |
| Package, all `skills/*/SKILL.md` | 4561 lines · 56328 tokens | 4557 lines · 56337 tokens |

## Tests

Docs-only: no package test suite reads `skills/**`. The gates that do are in *Verification*. No ablation (no tested behaviour changed).

## Acceptance notes

- `rules/indexing.md` L31 carries the `os migrate meta --from 16` prescription the deleted blockquote also quoted, so nothing an author could act on left the skill — only its second copy.
- No eval added: the card's Wanted names one paragraph; the `objectstack-data` evals do not exercise object extensions today, and an eval fixture is outside the token ratchet (ruling record 6513306068, letter B). Noted, not filed — an eval for the extension model is a `carrier: #28730`-adjacent follow-up the seat may order.

## Verification

Head `7ba013288b`, the branch's only commit; the tree is clean after every step below, so each reading is of this head. Prerequisites: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec --filter @objectstack/formula build`; then a whole-repo `pnpm build` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (`Tasks: 117 successful, 117 total`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`, held 13m57s) for the gates that read built output.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at head: 45 commands (34 derived for the SKILL.md alone, 11 more once the changeset existed — both derivations kept and run). Every command recorded with its exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran` verdict: **45 derived, 45 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**, exit 0.

First pass, before the whole-repo build, four did not pass and were traced to the checkout, not the diff: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, built output missing) and `check:dts-closure` exit 1 (`@objectstack/lint` declaration files missing — its dts build needs `@objectstack/sdui-parser` built first). After `pnpm build`: exit 0 each. The other 41: exit 0 on their first run.

Readings worth quoting:

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md is 6111 tokens (ceiling 6123; headroom 12)`; last line `57 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings; 10 generator-owned file(s) and 29 eval fixture(s) measured, not ratcheted`; exit 0. Its `--self-test`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:role-word`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges` — exit 0 each.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs` — exit 0. Extra, not derived: `check:skill-refs` — `9 generated files in sync with packages/spec`, exit 0.
- Changeset family: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:pm-changeset-deadline-census`, `check:published-files`, `check:closed-ceremony-text` — exit 0 each.
- Declared to CI, not run locally: `check:skill-examples` (not derived; the paragraph adds no fenced TypeScript block) and `test:repo`. The local-only families `check:dev-prereqs` / `check:skill-frame-freshness` were not run: the diff touches neither `packages/spec` nor a frame file.
